description: This release brings true lossless audio playback and downloads, enhanced offline queue support, and important security fixes to the updater.

changelog.title: Features & Improvements
items: Lossless Audio: Playback and downloads now properly respect user audio quality preferences, favoring FLAC/ALAC for Lossless and WebM for Opus

changelog.title: Bug Fixes
items: Security: Fixed an implicit PendingIntent vulnerability in the updater by explicitly resolving the installer package
Offline playback: Fixed an issue where offline songs were not being added to the play queue
